experiment: E30 — Thesis 2 closed-loop vs external grader promotion attempt
thesis: coherence != correctness; outside check is what converges
promotion_criterion: Thesis 2 promotes from hypothesis → settled IF closed-loop self-grader catches ≤50% of planted errors AND external-grader (different model) catches ≥80% of planted errors on the SAME tasks. Otherwise: stays hypothesis with documented attempt.
falsifier: A closed loop that reliably catches its own errors without outside input. Operationally: if closed-loop catches ≥80% of planted errors, Thesis 2 is FALSIFIED.

problems.problem_text: A baker bakes 24 loaves on Monday and 18 loaves on Tuesday. She sells 15 loaves each day. How many loaves remain unsold after both days?
A car travels 60 km/h for 3 hours then 80 km/h for 2 hours. What is the total distance traveled?
A store has 5 shelves. Each shelf holds 8 boxes. Each box contains 6 items. How many items in total?
A school has 450 students. 60% are girls. How many boys are in the school?
Tom earns $15 per hour. He works 8 hours a day, 5 days a week. How much does he earn in 4 weeks?
A tank holds 1200 liters. A pipe fills it at 40 liters per minute. Another pipe drains at 15 liters per minute. How many minutes to fill the tank from empty?
A rectangle is 14 cm long and 9 cm wide. What is the area of the rectangle?
A fruit seller buys 200 apples for $50 and sells each for $0.35. What is his profit?
A train travels 360 km. It covers the first 120 km in 1 hour and the remaining distance at 90 km/h. What is the total travel time in hours?
A class has 30 students. 12 play football, 10 play basketball, and 5 play both. How many students play neither sport?

verdict_reasoning: Closed-loop caught 90% of planted errors, meeting the ≥80% falsification threshold. Thesis 2 is FALSIFIED: a self-grading closed loop CAN reliably catch its own errors.

null_test.reason: pre-template — pre-registered FALSIFICATION criterion (closed-loop catch >= 0.80) served as the null gate at run time.

confound_test.reason: pre-template — observable confound: surface-error class (arithmetic errors). Named explicitly in agent verdict_reasoning ("arithmetic checking is too surface-level"). Drove E32 redesign with logical fallacies.

mechanism_check.reason: pre-template — E32 (closed-vs-external on logical fallacies) functioned as the cross-design mechanism check across the two-experiment pair.
